findings.detail: All 18 search screenshots visibly select the second result, the legitimate Form FAQ. Enter opens that result. The old helper still expects the LineEdit h1. findings.detail: At several narrow/tablet viewports the project name, lower tutorial fields/output or actions lie outside the captured viewport. Draft text is readable where visible; native value and node identity assertions remain separate evidence. Partial top/bottom controls are recorded per image and are not assumed complete or cropped product defects.

The guide checkbox named 未选择 is deliberately checked through its visible label by the native appearance test before changing preferences. Its fixed sample label is not treated as a derived on/off output; native checked and node identity checks remain separate.

All 18 1280x720 blank images were separately viewed. Existing representative trace triage identifies a secondary about:blank probe. No product white-screen defect, actual design configuration or component appearance approval is inferred.

failureTriage.limitations: Prior native trace triage confirms the representative md3/light/desktop action path. This audit checks the same native failure signature across all 18 cases; it does not claim separate trace-by-trace action review.
